claim: On the same 24-port fixed-termination 400 MHz instrument and matched extra observation budgets, a candidate-predicted cut may expose a registered finite-area ambiguity after independent acquisition and broad nonlinear refitting.
power_model: One available unit-power sum over eight unit-duration pulses per arm. Pulse duration is unspecified. Fully matched inactive ports.
noise_model: Deterministic Frobenius ball per acquisition. Real and imaginary iid Gaussian direction normalized to 2/3 of each declared radius. Different masks use the same coupled latent draw on common oriented channels; each new A or A reversal uses an independent acquisition draw relative to original A.
